paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Yevamot, chapter 1, halakhah 1, reporting in the name of Rabbi Yonatan of Beit Guvrin; at chapter 6, halakhah 2, he reported in the name of R' Abba bar Mamal.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Guggenheimer Yevamot 1:1 paragraph has Rabbi Avun bar Bisna in Rabbi Yonatan of Beit Guvrin’s name; the whole 6:2 paragraph has Rabbi Bun bar Bisna in Rabbi Ba bar Mamal’s name. Hyman’s Avin and Abba forms remain distinct, with R' where exact local full-title support is unavailable. The supplied סה״א and the two separate report directions are preserved; no name or identity harmonization follows.
